verdict.rationale: Format coverage is a fair question for a multi-format conversion tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents bitmap image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF) and image operations. Nothing shows ImageMagick reading or converting Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files to PDF or between office formats.

support.subject: As a power user, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files convert to PDF and between office formats
